description: Plan and price custom kit for a club or team: riders, pieces, optional size split and the date it's needed. Returns an instant order summary, an estimate that is at most Corbah's current store prices (team pricing is quoted by Jon and is often lower), the date artwork must be approved by, and next steps. Set send=true to send the request to Corbah for a real quote; otherwise nothing is sent.

callback_url.description: Optional https URL; Corbah POSTs to it when Jon replies

design.description: help = needs design help, kd = designed in Corbah's Kit Designer, have = artwork ready

each_rider.description: Shortcut: give every rider one of these pieces, e.g. ["ssj","bib"]

needed_by.description: Date the kit is needed, YYYY-MM-DD

notes.description: Colors, logos, event, budget, anything else

pieces.description: Quantity of each piece. Keys: ssj (short sleeve jersey), lsj (long sleeve jersey), bib (bib shorts), sui (skinsuit / tri suit), ves (wind vest), jac (jacket), arm (arm warmers), sho (shoe covers).

reply_to.description: Email of the person Jon should reply to (needed if send=true)

send.description: true = send this request to Corbah for a real quote. Default false (estimate only).

sizes.description: Optional size split, e.g. {"S":3,"M":6,"L":3}. Sizes: XS, S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL.

name: quote_team_kit
title: Team kit quote
